creator: Kenney
scope: All ten free audio packs in the current Kenney Audio catalog; excludes paid bundle-only and retired packs.
notes: Descriptions infer intent from original filenames and pack context, not listening. Numbered variants must be auditioned.
English voiceovers are archived assets, not Mandarin mission speech.
No files are wired into gameplay. Duck SFX during speech and mute during microphone capture.
Pack preview montages were removed; this catalog contains individual clips only.
